_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform — the CSV RFC 4180 `any` mutation vocabulary and the reference implementation that exercises it. The shared stdio manifest already registers `csv` under the `tabular-csv` capability for creation/projection; that entry cannot cover mutation because it never declared the capability, so this subset registers its own oracle id against the SAME package for the `csv-rfc4180-mutate` capability instead of reusing the shared one (would fail the contract with oracle-capability-mismatch).

oracles.rationale: The reference RFC 4180 CSV reader/writer of the Rust ecosystem, read with `has_headers(false)` and `flexible(true)` so it models the format the same way this subset's own schema does: no structural header/data distinction (only the `has_header` convention, which is metadata, not bytes) and per-record field counts as real information rather than an assumed rectangular grid. Used here to perform every declared `CsvMutation` kind independently of this repository's own codec.
